tools.name: exposure_counts_for_domain
tools.description: Credential-exposure counters for a domain. Counts only - no credential values or per-account detail. Sources: known breaches, infostealer infections, unattributed ULP bundles (heap), stolen cookies. All figures are INDEXATION dates, not incident dates: _month/_week mean 'newly indexed', never 'newly

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "exposure_counts_for_domain" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
